title: Japanese prompt: number of seasons in a year
rationale: Japanese users expect natural Japanese for a trivial cultural fact; a wrong count signals script or reasoning degradation in localized deployments.

prompt.content: あなたは正確なアシスタントです。日本語で短い一文だけで答えてください。説明は不要です。
一年には季節がいくつありますか？

notes: Language: Japanese. Expected answer token: 4, accepted as the ASCII digit 4, the full-width digit ４, or the kanji 四, so the natural answer 四季 also passes. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0. Brittleness: an English reply using the word 'four' fails because the system message requests Japanese; kanji-only answers are covered by the 四 branch.
